data.summary_en: EvoAlloc distills historical search/allocation results into reusable experience and, via counterfactual exploration, periodically revises candidate programs' compute-allocation strategy. On coding/agent-harness optimization benchmarks, it cuts baseline-reaching full evaluations by 59-82% and total LLM tokens by 61-89%, raising final performance by 8.7-12.0% at equal full-evaluation budget.
